rounding_convention: decimal.Decimal throughout, no floats; ROUND_HALF_UP quantized to cents per computation. Sales tax extracted from tax-inclusive totals as S = ROUND_HALF_UP(total / 1.06) with tax taken as the residual total - S, so the reclassification entry articulates exactly. Purchase discount = ROUND_HALF_UP(invoice x 0.02) on the invoice price only (freight excluded), with cash paid as the residual. No PV factors involved.
